question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word **Subterfuge.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Honesty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Subterfuge"** means deceit used to achieve one's goal or to escape a consequence. (छल, धोखा)

 
 
• **Example: **He had to resort to subterfuge to gain access to the restricted area.
 
 
 
• **"Honesty"** refers to the quality of being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud. (ईमानदारी)
 
 
• **Example: **Her honesty in admitting her mistake earned her respect from everyone in the team.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Subterfuge'** is **'Honesty'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Honesty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trickery** (चालाकी): The practice of deception or the use of tricks to achieve a goal.

 
 
• **Example:** His trickery in business dealings led to the downfall of his company.
 
 
 
• **Fraud** (धोखाधड़ी): Wrongful or criminal deception intended to result in financial or personal gain.
 
 
• **Example:** The company was accused of committing fraud by falsifying its financial statements.
 
 
 
• **Scheme** (योजना): A secret or underhanded plan or arrangement.
 
 
• **Example:** He devised a clever scheme to outwit his competitors.

The correct answer is option 1.&l
